lines: Yemeni civil war Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict, 2026 Yemen offensives Saudi Arabia–United Kingdom relations British Prime Minister Andy Burnham says that the United Kingdom will offer Saudi Arabia aerial refueling in its ongoing conflict with the Houthis. (The Hill)

2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war Pakistan's military launches strikes over the Afghanistan–Pakistan border in retaliation for the 2026 Kohat attack. Afghanistan's government and the UNAMA report that a family of three is killed in the strikes, while Pakistan claims strikes killed 28 Pakistani Taliban militants. (Reuters)
Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict The Red Sea International Film Festival in Saudi Arabia is postponed to 2027 due to the ongoing conflict with the Houthis. (Arab News)

Korean conflict An explosion injures three South Korean military officers during an operation inside the Demilitarized Zone, south of the military demarcation line. The Joint Chiefs of Staff says the cause remains unknown. (AFP via The Peninsula)
Two pilots are killed in a helicopter crash while fighting a fire in Yosemite National Park, California. (Reuters)
New Zealand's critically endangered black robin wins Forest & Bird's Bird of the Year competition with more than 26,000 votes out of about 105,000 votes. (AFP)

Singapore's Land Transport Authority introduces fines of up to S$500 (US$390) for eating on public buses or placing feet on seats, while severe cleanliness or safety violations can incur penalties of up to S$5,000 (US$3,900). (AFP)
